name: AIfa Memory
description: Hosted encrypted long-term memory for AI agents over Streamable HTTP at https://aifa.works/api/mcp with optional permanent Arweave anchoring (AES-256-GCM). Discovery (initialize, tools/list) is public; every tool call requires a per-user Bearer key from https://aifa.works/mcp. Read-only info tools (memory_about, plans, partner_kit) keep Guard's usual handling; every tool that reads or modifies private memory, creates payment invoices, requests payouts or configures webhooks is gated on review. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Run discovery (initialize and tools/list) without credentials; once a per-user Bearer key is configured, use read-only info tools (memory_about, plans, partner_kit) that do not read or modify private memory.
Keep memory_write, memory_export, buy_plan, request_payout and set_webhook on Review so private memory exports, invoices, payouts and webhooks require explicit approval.
